title: Greatness of Mordecai

questions.question: What did King Ahasuerus impose on the land?
questions.explanation: Esther 10:1 (ESV): "King Ahasuerus imposed tax on the land and on the coastlands of the sea."

questions.question: In which book were the acts of power recorded?
options: Book of the Chronicles of the kings of Media and Persia
questions.correctAnswer: Book of the Chronicles of the kings of Media and Persia
questions.explanation: Esther 10:2 (ESV): "...written in the Book of the Chronicles of the kings of Media and Persia?"

questions.question: What rank was Mordecai?
options: Second in rank to King Ahasuerus
questions.correctAnswer: Second in rank to King Ahasuerus
questions.explanation: Esther 10:3 (ESV): "For Mordecai the Jew was second in rank to King Ahasuerus..."

questions.question: How was Mordecai viewed by the Jews?
questions.explanation: Esther 10:3 (ESV): "...and he was great among the Jews and popular with the multitude of his brothers..."

questions.question: What was Mordecai’s goal for his people?
options: He sought the welfare of his people
questions.correctAnswer: He sought the welfare of his people
questions.explanation: Esther 10:3 (ESV): "...for he sought the welfare of his people..."

questions.question: What did Mordecai speak to all his people?
questions.explanation: Esther 10:3 (ESV): "...and spoke peace to all his people."

questions.question: On what region was the tax imposed?
options: On the land and on the coastlands of the sea
questions.correctAnswer: On the land and on the coastlands of the sea
questions.explanation: Esther 10:1 (ESV): "King Ahasuerus imposed tax on the land and on the coastlands of the sea."

questions.question: Whose greatness is described in this chapter?
questions.explanation: Esther 10:2 (ESV): "...and the full account of the high honor of Mordecai..."

questions.question: How many verses are in this chapter?
What specific detail about the recording of acts is mentioned?
options: All the acts of his power and his might
questions.correctAnswer: All the acts of his power and his might
questions.explanation: Esther 10:2 (ESV): "And all the acts of his power and of his might..."

questions.question: What does "popular with the multitude of his brothers" imply?
questions.explanation: Esther 10:3 (ESV): "...popular with the multitude of his brothers..."

questions.question: Who was King Ahasuerus historically identified as?
questions.explanation: Historically Ahasuerus is identified with Xerxes I (486-465 BC).

questions.question: What does the mention of "coastlands" indicate about the empire?
questions.explanation: Reference to coastlands indicates the vast reach of the empire.

questions.question: Is God mentioned by name in this chapter?
questions.explanation: God is not mentioned by name in the entire book of Esther.

key_verse_text: For Mordecai the Jew was second in rank to King Ahasuerus, and he was great among the Jews and popular with the multitude of his brothers, for he sought the welfare of his people and spoke peace to all his people.
